bio: Located on a small industrial estate on the outskirts of Lekunberri, Masakarada is a highly unusual and interesting eatery where everything revolves around the breed of pig known as Pío Negro or Euskal Txerri. The restaurant is perfectly complemented by a shop selling charcuterie, cheeses and fresh meat (jowl, cheek, and special Spanish cuts such as “secreto” and “pluma”). The business operates a 360° strategy that involves the rearing of happy pigs in complete liberty in the area around the nearby town of Arruitz. The cuisine here is showcased on two tasting menus: Maskarada and Suletina....
